description: Rhea is deciding whether to swap her vintage drum machine for a neighbor's synthesizer, and must settle the exact equipment, pickup arrangement, and setup help with input from the neighbor and a bandmate.

agents.name: Rhea
agents.role: Drum Machine Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Rhea owns a vintage drum machine and has said she would consider an informal swap for a compact synthesizer.
shared_context.S2: Cal has expressed interest in trading equipment with Rhea.
shared_context.S3: June regularly helps Rhea prepare and test gear for band projects.
shared_context.S4: For equipment swaps among these friends, the owner first asks the other party to state the complete offer, then asks the practical helper for any considerations before making the final call.

PF1.text: Cal's complete offer is his Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer, its original power adapter, and its soft case, with pickup on Friday at 6:00 p.m.; he will also provide a 30-minute setup session.

PF2.text: June learned from Rhea's bandmate Omar, who has not told Rhea yet, that Rhea's band is recording on Sunday and needs the replacement synthesizer in hand by Saturday at noon.

acceptance_conditions: The swap must be accepted for the Korg Minilogue XD.
The original power adapter and soft case must be included.
Pickup must be set for Friday at 6:00 p.m.
Cal must provide a 30-minute setup session.
The synthesizer must be in Rhea's hands by Saturday at noon.
The Saturday-noon requirement must be credited to June's disclosed information.

content_checks.C1: decisions['swap_accepted'] == True and decisions['item_received'] == 'Korg Minilogue XD'
content_checks.C4: decisions['setup_session_included'] == True and any(c['type'] == 'setup_session' and c['target'] == 'Cal' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['gear_in_hand_by'] == 'Saturday at noon' and any(c['type'] == 'delivery_deadline' and c['detail'] == 'Saturday at noon' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Cal's complete offer changes the unidentified possible swap into a Korg Minilogue XD with the exact adapter, soft case, Friday 6:00 p.m. pickup, and 30-minute setup session required by the settlement.

June's information changes the delivery requirement from no stated deadline to having the synthesizer in hand by the exact time of Saturday at noon, and supplies the fact that Rhea must cite for that deadline.
